title: Building of lanthanide oxoalkoxides: synthesis and molecular structure of [Gd6(μ4-O)(μ3,η2-OR)4(μ,η2-OR)6(μ,η1-OR)2(OR)4] (R = C2H4OMe)

material_class.structural_family: hexanuclear oxoalkoxide assembled from two trinuclear units via a tetrahedral μ4-oxo ligand

synthesis.procedure: All manipulations were performed under argon using Schlenk tubes and vacuum-line techniques. Route A: gadolinium chips (3 g, 19 mmol) were allowed to react with a 1:1 mixture of toluene and 2-methoxyethanol (50 cm3). After addition of 10 mg of a mercury(II) catalyst [HgCl2:Hg(OAc)2], the mixture was refluxed for 30 h. Metal colloids were removed by hot filtration. After stripping to dryness, the pasty solid was recrystallized from petroleum ether (6 g, 88%). Route B (alcohol interchange): 0.618 g (0.39 mmol) of Gd5O(OPri)13 in 15 cm3 of toluene was reacted with 2-methoxyethanol (0.6 cm3, 7.62 mmol) in 5 cm3 of toluene for 1 h. Evaporation to dryness and similar work-up gave 1 (0.64 g, 91%). Compound 1 is soluble in common organic solvents except petroleum ether.

reagents.name: 2-methoxyethanol
reagents.amount: 50 cm3 toluene–2-methoxyethanol (1:1) (route A); 0.6 cm3, 7.62 mmol (route B)

synthesis.temperature: reflux (route A); unspecified ambient conditions for 1 h (route B)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk tubes and vacuum-line techniques under argon; reflux of metal chips with mercury(II) catalyst (route A); alcohol interchange in toluene (route B)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Hot filtration to remove metal colloids (route A); stripping/evaporation to dryness; recrystallization from petroleum ether. X-ray-quality crystals obtained from the recrystallized product.

properties.summary: Room-temperature ESR in toluene gives ⟨g⟩ = 2.065 and an effective magnetic moment μ = 15.60 μB. The authors note that variable-temperature magnetic susceptibility would be needed to quantify exchange among the Gd(III) (S = 7/2) centres; no optical/luminescence data are reported.
